{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/trial.csv')

# Check for sentinel values in biomarker_baseline
print(f"Number of -999 values in biomarker_baseline: {df[df['biomarker_baseline'] == -999].shape[0]}")

# Check for duplicates in patient_id
print(f"Number of duplicate patient_id values: {df.duplicated(subset=['patient_id']).sum()}")

# Check for re-tests (sample_seq > 1)
print(f"Number of patients with multiple sample_seq: {df.groupby('patient_id')['sample_seq'].max().gt(1).sum()}")

# Check unique values in key columns
print(f"Unique arms: {df['arm'].unique()}")
print(f"Unique severities: {df['severity'].unique()}")
print(f"Unique assay_batches: {df['assay_batch'].unique()}")

# Check if any patient has more than one sample_seq
retest_counts = df.groupby('patient_id')['sample_seq'].max()
print(f"Max sample_seq per patient: {retest_counts.max()}")

# Check if any patient has multiple rows with sample_seq == 1
# (this would be unusual but possible)
print(f"Patients with multiple rows and sample_seq == 1: {df[df['sample_seq'] == 1].groupby('patient_id').size().gt(1).sum()}")

# Check the premises
premise_1 = 'moderate' in df[df['arm'] == 'control']['severity'].unique()
print(f"Premise 1 (moderate severity in control arm): {premise_1}")

# Check if 'responded' is binary and 0/1
print(f"Unique values in 'responded': {df['responded'].unique()}")

# Check that the data has one row per patient after deduplication
# We'll do this after deduplication, but first note: we have 848 rows
print(f"Total rows: {df.shape[0]}")

# Check if any patient_id appears more than once
print(f"Number of unique patient_ids: {df['patient_id'].nunique()}")

# Check the distribution of sample_seq
print(f"Distribution of sample_seq: {df['sample_seq'].value_counts().sort_index()}")"}
